about.title: About Us
about.historyText1: ZEWA Group (Zero E-Waste Africa) began with a clear and urgent mission to safeguard Africa’s environment by transforming the way electronic waste is managed, what started as a modest initiative has grown into a continent-wide force driving responsible collection, recycling, and sustainable resource recovery. Over the years, we have collaborated with leading organizations, governmental bodies, and community stakeholders to ensure that electronic waste is collected, processed, and recycled safely with transparency and in full compliance with global WEEE standards.To us, every discarded device is more than just waste, it is a chance to create value, recover critical resources, protect public health, and prevent environmental pollution while guided by innovation, integrity, and a deep commitment to environmental stewardship, ZEWA Group continues to advance Africa’s transition toward a cleaner, greener, and fully circular future.
about.historyText2: ZEWA Group (Zero E-Waste Africa) is a leading Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) management company committed to accelerating Africa’s shift toward a sustainable circular economy. Since our inception, we have focused on reducing environmental impact, promoting responsible collection, recycling and maximizing resource recovery through innovative, compliant, and eco-efficient waste-management solutions. We serve SMEs, multinational corporations, and government institutions across Africa, providing seamless end-to-end services from e-waste collection and pre-processing to secure data destruction and environmentally responsible disposal of obsolete or damaged electronic equipment. Through our integrated operations, ZEWA Group enhances circularity, safeguards the environment, and empowers organizations to achieve their sustainability goals, regulatory compliance, and low-carbon objectives. Our Core Focus is to be environmentally responsible for WEEE management and Circular Economy sustainability
about.complianceText: Our operations align with globally recognized environmental laws and sustainability frameworks, which environmental protection, public health, and regulatory compliance form the foundation of our group commitment and our activities are also aligned with:
about.presenceText: We operate across multiple African nations through our cross-border waste-management initiative, which means reaching out to us from any part of Africa is never an issue

basel.title: The Basel Convention
basel.text: We adhere to the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous & E-Waste Disposal, a global treaty adopted to ensure all hazardous & electronic waste is collected, handled, and processed responsibly, safely, and legally.

partnerships.title: Sustainability & Partnerships
partnerships.text: We collaborate with governments, NGOs, and private organizations to promote circular economy through refurbishment, reuse, & recycle by also creating public awareness initiatives.

iso.title: Certification & Global Standard
iso.text: Our Environmental Management System align with standard sustainability performance, which allow us to comply fully with national and international environmental law & regulations, aligning with best practices of WEEE Directive.

circular.title: Circular Economy Vision
circular.text: We envision a truly circular Africa where resources are continually recovered, reused, and reintegrated into the economy, also our goal is to eliminate waste, reduce pollution, and build a resilient, sustainable future for communities and industries across the continent.

info.heading: Our Commitment Toward Environmental Sustainability
info.subheading: We committed to protecting the environment through responsible and sustainable practices, while championing Africa’s shift toward a cleaner and more circular economy with our work focuses on innovation that reduces waste and preserves natural resources through education and awareness and empowering communities to adopt greener habits.

cards.title: Sustainable Waste Management
cards.text: At ZEWA Group, we promote a sustainable waste management model built on the principles of: Repair → Refurbish → Reuse → Recycle.

cards.title: Protecting the Environment
cards.text: We are dedicated to protecting the environment through responsible waste management, reducing pollution, and fostering a circular economy for a cleaner, more sustainable future.

cards.title: Reducing Carbon Emissions
cards.text: ZEWA is committed to reducing carbon emissions through sustainable recycling, energy-efficient operations, and green initiatives, helping organizations achieve their low-carbon goals across Africa.

cards.title: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)
cards.text: We uphold Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) by ensuring responsible collection, recycling, and management of electronic waste, helping organizations and partners meet environmental and regulatory standards.

cards.title: Training & Awareness
cards.text: Through our expert waste management programs, we help organizations adopt sustainable operations by providing training and awareness that promote e-waste management and eco-friendly practices.

cards.title: Promote Circular Economy
cards.text: We supports Africa’s transition to a circular economy by promoting responsible resource recovery & sustainable manufacturing. We align with global circular economy principles through innovation, 5R culture, and waste reduction systems.
cards.more: Our focus is creating long-term environmental and economic value by keeping materials in use and minimizing ecological impact.

operations.heading: How We Operate
operations.description: At ZEWA Group, we focus on efficiency, transparency, and environmental responsibility. Every stage ensures electronic waste is collected, processed, and transformed safely, traceably, and in full compliance with regulatory standards.

whyWeMatter.heading: Why Do We Matter?
whyWeMatter.description: Electronic waste is one of the fastest-growing waste streams globally. Across Africa, where informal disposal is common, ZEWA’s presence makes a vital difference.

reasons.title: Environmental Protection
reasons.desc: We prevent contamination and pollution by ensuring e-waste is disposed of safely and responsibly.

reasons.desc: We support safer communities through responsible recycling practices that protect lives and the environment.

reasons.title: Green Job Creation
reasons.desc: Our operations create sustainable employment opportunities and promote economic independence.

reasons.title: Carbon Reduction & Climate Action
reasons.desc: We actively contribute to Sustainable Development Goals, we encourage repairs, refurbishing, and reuse before recycling to minimize environmental impact.

sustainability.heading: Our Sustainability Goal
sustainability.description: Our sustainability goal is to minimize environmental impact by driving responsible e-waste recovery and recycling, also to promote a circular economy that keeps valuable materials in use and out of landfills. By 2030, ZEWA Group aims to reduce its operational carbon emissions by 65% through optimized waste collection, renewable energy adoption, and active participation in reforestation initiatives.
